environment.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 A Laptop GPU

families.description: All accessible evaluation/benchmark models. Loaded only by the research benchmark entry points (scripts/benchmark_*.py), never during normal user processing.

families.name: Diffusion image editing
families.mechanism: latent denoising conditioned on the input image

models.name: Stable Diffusion 1.5 U-Net + VAE + text encoder
models.note: Differentiable anti-diffusion surrogate: the optimizer maximizes its denoising error, so downstream editors conditioned on the protected photo reconstruct the subject poorly (PhotoGuard-style end-to-end attack).

families.name: Masked inpainting
families.protection_target: mask-robust protection (evaluated over real mask kinds)

models.name: Stable Diffusion 1.5 U-Net + VAE + text encoder
models.note: Differentiable anti-diffusion surrogate: the optimizer maximizes its denoising error, so downstream editors conditioned on the protected photo reconstruct the subject poorly (PhotoGuard-style end-to-end attack).

models.name: Stable Diffusion 1.5 Inpainting (9-channel U-Net)
models.note: Real masked-inpainting evaluation over face/person-derived mask kinds (shirt, hair, background, person, irregular).

models.name: InstructPix2Pix
models.note: HELD OUT: never exposed to the optimizer. The strongest transferability evidence in the direct-editing family.

families.name: Image-to-image generation
families.mechanism: encode/noise/denoise from a source image + prompt

models.name: Stable Diffusion 1.5 U-Net + VAE + text encoder
models.note: Differentiable anti-diffusion surrogate: the optimizer maximizes its denoising error, so downstream editors conditioned on the protected photo reconstruct the subject poorly (PhotoGuard-style end-to-end attack).

models.name: SD1.5 image-to-image (evaluation)
models.note: Style/attribute img2img evaluation across denoising strengths.

families.name: Identity/reference-conditioned generation
families.mechanism: reference photo -> identity encoder -> new synthetic image

models.name: FaceNet (InceptionResnetV1, VGGFace2)
models.note: Differentiable identity encoder. The optimizer pushes the protected face's embedding away from the original, reducing its usefulness as a reference identity for reference-conditioned generation and face-swap pipelines.

models.name: FaceNet (InceptionResnetV1, CASIA-WebFace)
models.note: Second identity encoder for within-family transfer evaluation.

models.name: ArcFace (MobileFaceNet, insightface)
models.note: HELD OUT: never used during optimization. Measures how well identity disruption transfers to a different identity encoder family.

families.name: Face-swap / identity transfer
families.mechanism: source face -> target image/video identity transfer
families.protection_target: identity-source disruption (same embedding objective as E)

models.name: FaceNet (InceptionResnetV1, VGGFace2)
models.note: Differentiable identity encoder. The optimizer pushes the protected face's embedding away from the original, reducing its usefulness as a reference identity for reference-conditioned generation and face-swap pipelines.

models.name: FaceNet (InceptionResnetV1, CASIA-WebFace)
models.note: Second identity encoder for within-family transfer evaluation.

models.name: ArcFace (MobileFaceNet, insightface)
models.note: HELD OUT: never used during optimization. Measures how well identity disruption transfers to a different identity encoder family.

families.name: Image-to-video / face-video generation
families.mechanism: reference image + motion/target video -> synthetic video
families.protection_target: reference/video disruption (adapter registered; model too heavy for dev GPU)
families.research_basis: spec §17 — optional; documented unavailable rather than faked

models.name: Image-to-video (modular adapter)
models.note: Family registered with a modular adapter; local video-generation weights are far beyond the development GPU, so this family is reported as NOT TESTED rather than faked. Identity disruption (family E/F) is the surrogate evidence.

families.name: Vision-language / multimodal conditioning
families.mechanism: image encoder + language-conditioned representations before generation

models.name: CLIP ViT-L/14
models.note: Evaluation only: auxiliary semantic scoring + vision-language representation distance. Not used to generate the perturbation.

families.name: General vision/image encoders
families.mechanism: learned visual representation used as conditioning or feature extractor

models.name: MobileNetV3-Large (ImageNet)
models.note: Differentiable global vision encoder: disrupts common visual representations image-wide, improving cross-pipeline transfer.

models.name: ResNet50 (ImageNet) — held-out
models.note: HELD OUT vision encoder: transferability test for feature disruption.

models.name: CLIP ViT-L/14
models.note: Evaluation only: auxiliary semantic scoring + vision-language representation distance. Not used to generate the perturbation.

editing_protection.note: Families targeted: diffusion editing, instruction editing, inpainting, image-to-image, identity-reference, face-swap, vision encoders. single multi-family perturbation applied (eps=0.0175, 1 iters); denoising error 1.809 -> 2.039; SSIM 0.990; identity similarity 0.998 -> 0.991; vision similarity 0.996 -> 0.812.
editing_protection.objective: single multi-family perturbation: diffusion editing (A-D) + identity-reference/face-swap (E-F) + vision encoders (I)
